thesis.one_liner: SE Asian superapp with reaccelerating growth and eighteen straight quarters of adjusted EBITDA growth; the main overhang is the year-long unresolved GoTo merger saga rather than the operating business.
thesis.kill_switch: GoTo drags on unresolved for another year while competitive incentive spending re-escalates in Indonesia, compressing margins back toward 2024 levels.

kbqs.question: Is the profitability trajectory durable operating leverage, or dependent on temporarily reduced competitive intensity?
Does the GoTo situation resolve value-additively, neutrally, or destructively?
Can the foodpanda and Superbank integrations deliver on the 2027-2028 guided timeline?

summary: Record Q2 with bookings up 22% and EBITDA up 54%, plus a new $750m buyback. Best asymmetry of the names reviewed in this batch at roughly 2.5:1. The GoTo question remains the single largest unresolved variable.
